query:
UPDATE cars 
SET dealerId = 1,
    auctionStartDate = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY),
    auctionEndDate = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 DAY),
    startingBid = FLOOR(CAST(price AS DECIMAL) * 0.7),
    reservePrice = FLOOR(CAST(price AS DECIMAL) * 0.85),
    buyNowPrice = price
WHERE isAuction = 1 AND dealerId IS NULL;
